findings.quoted_text: 9.1.1 The Liability Cap will not apply to any (1) material confidentiality breach under Section 5, and/or (2) indemnification obligations under Section 7.1.
except that if the default is by Supplier that creates an immediate public food safety risk, PNC may terminate this Agreement immediately without regard to any period for correction.
findings.explanation: Only the Client has the right to terminate the contract immediately for a food safety risk without a cure period, while your right to terminate is subject to standard notice and cure periods.
findings.suggested_change: Either Party may terminate this Agreement immediately if the other Party commits a material breach that creates an immediate public safety risk and cannot be cured.

findings.quoted_text: 9.1.1 The Liability Cap will not apply to any (1) material confidentiality breach under Section 5, and/or (2) indemnification obligations under Section 7.1.
findings.explanation: Your indemnification obligations and potential confidentiality breaches are excluded from the liability cap, meaning your financial exposure for these claims is completely uncapped.
findings.suggested_change: The Liability Cap shall apply to all claims and obligations under this Agreement, including indemnification and confidentiality.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are doing well. I am writing to propose a few minor adjustments to the agreement before I sign it. - Regarding the relevant clause where your indemnification obligations and potential confidentiality breaches are excluded from the liability cap, meaning your financial exposure for these claims is completely uncapped, I suggest updating it so that the Liability Cap shall apply to all claims and obligations under this Agreement, including indemnification and confidentiality. Best regards,
